text:
emily: Heads-up — we've got a reproducible double-charge case for customers using the multiplexed streaming client (multiple logical streams over one socket). Repro: start two substreams A & B, A finishes, B reconnects after a transient and retries; billing shows tokens for overlap charged twice. Logs attached: `session=abcd1234 sub=1 chunk=42 ack=...` :eyes:

sanjay: Can you paste the minimal client/server exchange? Is client sending an idempotency token per chunk?
emily: Client only sends `x-session-id: abcd1234`. We don't have a distinct `substream-id` in the ledger keys. Payload has `substream_index=1` but server ledger key uses session only. So when B reconnects we create a provisional charge which later becomes confirmed while the original session owner ledger entry remains — effectively double charge.
mira: That matches a hypothesis I had. Two quick Qs: 1) Is this strictly a multiplexing-only issue (separate TCP connections don't hit this)? 2) How frequent is it in prod?
emily: Verified it's multiplexing-specific. Frequency: ~1% of multiplexed sessions in canary logs, hit in 3 paying customers so far. Sample log: ```INFO stream.recv session=abcd1234 sub=2 chunk=55 retry=true provisional_tokens=12 confirmed_tokens=12```
tom: Proposed fix: include `substream-id` in the ledger key (ledger_key = session_id|substream_id|chunk_seq). Pros: straightforward reconciliation per-logical-stream and prevents cross-substream dupes. Cons: increases cardinality in ledgers/metrics and needs a migration plan for old entries.
sanjay: Alternative: keep session-only ledger but require an `idempotency-token` per chunk that server uses to de-duplicate across reconnects and map token->owner. That reduces ledger cardinality but adds lookup/state and might be heavier on the hot path.
mira: From a telemetry/UX perspective we need visibility BEFORE rollout. Console currently aggregates by session/customer. We should add a "streaming: per-substream provisional vs confirmed" panel and a simple query: `sum(provisional_tokens)-sum(confirmed_tokens) by substream_id` to catch regressions. Also display the ratio of reconnections that produced provisional-only tokens.
devops-bot: deploy: canary flag `stream_subledger` toggled -> eng-platform-canary at 15:12 UTC :rocket:
emily: Rollout plan suggestion: server-side feature flag, default off. Steps: 1) enable `stream_subledger` on 1% traffic for 24h; 2) monitor provisional gap and error rate; 3) expand to 10% then 100% if green. Emit telemetry events `stream.ledger.assign` and `stream.ledger.reconcile` with minimal schema.
tom: We also need a short-lived reconciler run when flipping the flag to dedupe pre-existing ghost tokens (window ~48h). That will mitigate historical duplicates created before change.
sanjay: I'll add unit/integration tests that fuzz reconnects and assert no double-charge across many reconnection patterns. Also add a benchmark for the per-chunk lookup cost if we go idempotency-token route.
mira: UX ask for Rollouts UI: add a toggle for "Enable per-substream ledger" with a link to docs and show estimated token delta during canary (simulated from sample logs). Add a per-customer heatmap for provisional delta so SRE can roll back if a big customer regresses.
emily: Action items: emily -> open ticket and doc; sanjay -> spike implementation (owns), tom -> scope reconciler; mira -> mock dashboard panels and alert queries. I'll also draft telemetry schema PR. @sanjay please own the initial PR. :thumbsup:
sanjay: I'll start the spike today, aim for a prototype PR by EOD.
emily: Thanks — will follow up with the ticket and add monitoring alerts.
